25.8: and he went after the man of Yisra’ĕl into the tent and thrust both of them through, the man of Yisra’ĕl, and the woman through her abdomen. Thus the plague among the children of Yisra’ĕl came to a stop.
25.9: And those who died in the plague were twenty-four thousand.
25.10: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Mosheh, saying,
25.11: “Pineḥas, son of El’azar, son of Aharon the kohĕn, has turned back My wrath from the children of Yisra’ĕl, because he was ardent with My ardor in their midst, so that I did not consume the children of Yisra’ĕl in My ardor.
25.12: “Therefore say, ‘See, I am giving him My covenant of peace,
25.13: and it shall be to him and to his seed after him a covenant of an everlasting kehunnah, because he was ardent for his Elohim, and made atonement for the children of Yisra’ĕl.’ ”
25.14: And the name of the Yisra’ĕlite who was killed, who was killed with the Miḏyanite woman, was Zimri, son of Salu, a leader of a father’s house among the Shim’onites.
25.15: And the name of the Miḏyanite woman who was killed was Kozbi the daughter of Tsur. He was head of the people of a father’s house in Miḏyan.
25.16: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Mosheh, saying,
25.17: “Distress the Miḏyanites! And you shall smite them,
25.18: for they distressed you with their tricks with which they deceived you in the matter of Pe’or and in the matter of Kozbi, the daughter of a leader of Miḏyan, their sister, who was killed in the day of the plague because of Pe’or.”

26.1: And it came to be, after the plague, that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Mosheh and El’azar, son of Aharon the kohĕn, saying,
26.2: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Yisra’ĕl from twenty years old and above, by their fathers’ houses, everyone going out to the army in Yisra’ĕl.”
26.3: So Mosheh and El’azar the kohĕn spoke with them in the desert plains of Mo’aḇ by the Yardĕn of Yeriḥo, saying,
26.4: “From twenty years old and above, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 commanded Mosheh and the children of Yisra’ĕl who came out of the land of Mitsrayim.”
26.5: Re’uḇĕn, first-born of Yisra’ĕl, sons of Re’uḇĕn: of Ḥanoḵ, the clan of the Ḥanoḵites; of Pallu, the clan of the Palluites;
26.6: of Ḥetsron, the clan of the Ḥetsronites; of Karmi, the clan of the Karmites.
26.7: These are the clans of the Re’uḇĕnites, and their registered ones were forty-three thousand seven hundred and thirty.
26.8: And the son of Pallu: Eliyaḇ.
26.9: And the sons of Eliyaḇ: Nemu’ĕl, and Dathan, and Aḇiram. This Dathan and Aḇiram, were the called ones of the congregation, who contended against Mosheh and against Aharon in the company of Qoraḥ, when they contended against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄,
26.10: and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up together with Qoraḥ when that company died, when the fire consumed two hundred and fifty men. And they became a sign,
26.11: but the sons of Qoraḥ did not die.
26.12: Sons of Shim’on according to their clans: of Nemu’ĕl, the clan of the Nemu’ĕlites; of Yamin, the clan of the Yaminites; of Yaḵin, the clan of the Yaḵinites;
26.13: of Zeraḥ, the clan of the Zarḥites; of Sha’ul, the clan of the Sha’ulites.
26.14: These are the clans of the Shim’onites: twenty-two thousand two hundred.
26.15: Sons of Gaḏ according to their clans: of Tsephon, the clan of the Tsephonites; of Ḥaggi, the clan of the Ḥaggites; of Shuni, the clan of the Shunites;
26.16: of Ozni, the clan of the Oznites; of Ĕri, the clan of the Ĕrites;
26.17: of Aroḏ, the clan of the Aroḏites; of Arĕli, the clan of the Arĕlites.
26.18: These are the clans of the sons of Gaḏ according to their registered ones: forty thousand five hundred.
26.19: Sons of Yahuḏah: Ĕr and Onan. And Ĕr and Onan died in the land of Kena’an.
26.20: And sons of Yahuḏah according to their clans: of Shĕlah, the clan of the Shĕlanites; of Perets, the clan of the Partsites; of Zeraḥ, the clan of the Zarḥites.
26.21: And sons of Perets: of Ḥetsron, the clan of the Ḥetsronites; of Ḥamul, the clan of the Ḥamulites.
26.22: These are the clans of Yahuḏah according to their registered ones: seventy-six thousand five hundred.
26.23: Sons of Yissasḵar according to their clans: of Tola, the clan of the Tolaites; of Puwwah, the clan of the Punites;
26.24: of Yashuḇ, the clan of the Yashuḇites; of Shimron, the clan of the Shimronites.
26.25: These are the clans of Yissasḵar according to their registered ones: sixty-four thousand three hundred.
26.26: Sons of Zeḇulun according to their clans: of Sereḏ, the clan of the Sardites; of Ĕlon, the clan of the Ĕlonites; of Yaḥle’ĕl, the clan of the Yaḥle’ĕlites.
26.27: These are the clans of the Zeḇulunites according to their registered ones: sixty thousand five hundred.
26.28: Sons of Yosĕph according to their clans, by Menashsheh and Ephrayim:
26.29: Sons of Menashsheh: of Maḵir, the clan of the Maḵirites. And Maḵir brought forth Gil’aḏ; of Gil’aḏ, the clan of the Gil’aḏites.
26.30: These are sons of Gil’aḏ: of Iyezer, the clan of the Iyezerites; of Ḥĕleq, the clan of the Ḥĕleqites;
26.31: of Asri’ĕl, the clan of the Asri’ĕlites; of Sheḵem, the clan of the Sheḵemites;
26.32: of Shemiḏa, the clan of the Shemiḏaites; of Ḥĕpher, the clan of the Ḥĕpherites.
26.33: And Tselapheḥaḏ son of Ḥĕpher had no sons, but daughters. And the names of the daughters of Tselapheḥaḏ: Maḥlah, and No’ah, Ḥoḡlah, Milkah, and Tirtsah.
26.34: These are the clans of Menashsheh, and their registered ones: fifty-two thousand seven hundred.
26.35: These are the sons of Ephrayim according to their clans: of Shuthelaḥ, the clan of the Shuthalḥites; of Beḵer, the clan of the Baḵrites; of Taḥan, the clan of the Taḥanites.
26.36: And these are sons of Shuthelaḥ: of Ĕran, the clan of the Ĕranites.
26.37: These are the clans of the sons of Ephrayim according to their registered ones: thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Yosĕph according to their clans.
26.38: Sons of Binyamin according to their clans: of Bela, the clan of the Belaites; of Ashbĕl, the clan of the Ashbĕlites; of Aḥiram, the clan of the Aḥiramites;
26.39: of Shephupham, the clan of the Shephuphamites; of Ḥupham, the clan of the Ḥuphamites.
26.40: And sons of Bela were Ard and Na’aman: of Ard, the clan of the Ardites; of Na’aman, the clan of the Na’amites.
26.41: These are sons of Binyamin according to their clans, and their registered ones: forty-five thousand six hundred.
26.42: These are sons of Dan according to their clans: of Shuḥam, the clan of the Shuḥamites. These are the clans of Dan according to their clans.
26.43: All the clans, of the Shuḥamites, according to their registered ones: sixty-four thousand four hundred.
26.44: Sons of Ashĕr according to their clans: of Yimnah, the clan of the Yimnahites; of Yishwi, the clan of the Yishwites; of Beri’ah, the clan of the Beri’ites.
26.45: Of the sons of Beri’ah: of Ḥeḇer, the clan of the Ḥeḇerites; of Malki’ĕl, the clan of the Malki’ĕlites.
26.46: And the name of the daughter of Ashĕr was Seraḥ.
26.47: These are the clans of the sons of Ashĕr according to their registered ones: fifty-three thousand four hundred.
26.48: Sons of Naphtali according to their clans: of Yaḥtse’ĕl, the clan of the Yaḥtse’ĕlites; of Guni, the clan of the Gunites;
26.49: of Yĕtser, the clan of the Yĕtserites; of Shillĕm, the clan of the Shillĕmites.
26.50: These are the clans of Naphtali according to their clans, and their registered ones: forty-five thousand four hundred.
26.51: These are the registered ones of the children of Yisra’ĕl: six hundred and one thousand seven hundred and thirty.
26.52: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Mosheh, saying,
26.53: “The land is to be divided to these as an inheritance, according to the number of names.
26.54: “To the large one you give a larger inheritance, and to the small one you give a smaller inheritance. Each shall be given its inheritance according to their registered ones.
26.55: “But the land is divided by lot, they inherit according to the names of the tribes of their fathers.
26.56: “According to the lot their inheritance is divided between the larger and the smaller.”
26.57: And these are the registered ones of the Lĕwites according to their clans: of Gĕreshon, the clan of the Gĕreshonites; of Qehath, the clan of the Qehathites; of Merari, the clan of the Merarites.
26.58: These are the clans of the Lĕwites: the clan of the Liḇnites, the clan of the Ḥeḇronites, the clan of the Maḥlites, the clan of the Mushites, and the clan of the Qorḥites. And Qehath brought forth Amram.
26.59: And the name of Amram’s wife was Yoḵeḇeḏ the daughter of Lĕwi, who was born to Lĕwi in Mitsrayim. And to Amram she bore Aharon and Mosheh and their sister Miryam.
26.60: And to Aharon were born Naḏaḇ and Aḇihu, El’azar and Ithamar.
26.61: And Naḏaḇ and Aḇihu died when they brought strange fire before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
26.62: And their registered ones were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and above. For they were not registered among the other children of Yisra’ĕl, because there was no inheritance given to them among the children of Yisra’ĕl.
26.63: These are the ones registered by Mosheh and El’azar the kohĕn, who registered the sons of Yisra’ĕl in the desert plains of Mo’aḇ by the Yardĕn of Yeriḥo.
26.64: But among these there was not a man of those registered by Mosheh and Aharon the kohĕn when they registered the sons of Yisra’ĕl in the Wilderness of Sinai.
26.65: For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 had said of them, “They shall certainly die in the wilderness.” And not a man was left of them, except Kalĕḇ son of Yephunneh, and Yahoshua son of Nun.

27.1: Then came the daughters of Tselapheḥaḏ, son of Ḥĕpher, son of Gil’aḏ, son of Maḵir, son of Menashsheh, from the clans of Menashsheh, son of Yosĕph. And these were the names of his daughters: Maḥlah, No’ah, and Ḥoḡlah, and Milkah, and Tirtsah.
27.2: And they stood before Mosheh, and before El’azar the kohĕn, and before the leaders and all the congregation, by the doorway of the Tent of Appointment, saying,
27.3: “Our father died in the wilderness, yet he was not in the company of those who were met together against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, in company with Qoraḥ, but he died in his own sin. And he had no sons.
27.4: “Why should the name of our father be removed from among his clan because he had no son? Give us a possession among the brothers of our father.”
27.5: Mosheh then brought their case before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
27.6: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Mosheh, saying,
27.7: “The daughters of Tselapheḥaḏ speak what is right. You should certainly give them a possession of inheritance among their father’s brothers, and cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.
27.8: “And speak to the children of Yisra’ĕl, saying, ‘When a man dies and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.
27.9: ‘And if he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.
27.10: ‘And if he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.
27.11: ‘And if his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to the nearest relative in his clan, and he shall possess it.’ ” And it shall be to the children of Yisra’ĕl a Law of Right-Ruling, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 commanded Mosheh.
27.12: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 said to Mosheh, “Go up into this Mount Aḇarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Yisra’ĕl.
27.13: “And when you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people as Aharon your brother was gathered,
27.14: because you rebelled against My mouth in the Wilderness of Tsin, in the strife of the congregation, to qadosh Me at the waters before their eyes.” These were the waters of Meriḇah, at Qaḏĕsh in the Wilderness of Tsin.
27.15: And Mosheh spoke to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, saying,
27.16: “Let 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, the Elohim of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,
27.17: who goes out before them and comes in before them, who leads them out and brings them in, so that the congregation of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 be not like sheep without a shepherd.”
27.18: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 said to Mosheh, “Take Yahoshua son of Nun with you, a man in whom is the Ruaḥ. And you shall lay your hand on him,
27.19: and shall stand him before El’azar the kohĕn and before all the congregation, and give him charge before their eyes,
27.20: and shall put some of your esteem upon him, so that all the congregation of the children of Yisra’ĕl obey.
27.21: “And he is to stand before El’azar the kohĕn, who shall inquire before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 for him by the right-ruling of the Urim. At his word they go out, and at his word they come in, both he and all the children of Yisra’ĕl with him, all the congregation.”
27.22: And Mosheh did as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 commanded him, and took Yahoshua and stood him before El’azar the kohĕn and before all the congregation,
27.23: and laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 commanded by the hand of Mosheh.

28.1: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Mosheh, saying,
28.2: “Command the children of Yisra’ĕl, and you shall say to them, ‘Take heed to bring My offering, My food for My offerings made by fire as a sweet fragrance to Me, at their Appointed Time.’
28.3: “And you shall say to them, ‘This is the offering made by fire which you bring to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄: two male lambs a year old, perfect ones, daily, a continual burnt offering.
28.4: ‘The one lamb you prepare in the morning, and the other lamb you prepare between the evenings,
28.5: with one-tenth of an ĕphah of fine flour as a grain offering mixed with one-fourth of a hin of pressed oil,
28.6: a continual burnt offering which was offered at Mount Sinai for a sweet fragrance, an offering made by fire to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄,
28.7: and its drink offering, one-fourth of a hin for each lamb. Pour out the drink to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 as an offering in the qodesh place.
28.8: ‘And the other lamb you prepare between the evenings. As the morning grain offering and its drink offering, you prepare it as an offering made by fire, a sweet fragrance to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
28.9: ‘And on the Shabbath day two lambs a year old, perfect ones, and two-tenth parts of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, with its drink offering,
28.10: the burnt offering for every Shabbath, besides the continual burnt offering with its drink offering.
28.11: ‘And on the beginnings of your months you bring near a burnt offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄: two young bulls and one ram, and seven lambs a year old, perfect ones;
28.12: three-tenth parts of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, for each bull; two-tenth parts of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, for the one ram;
28.13: and one-tenth part of fine flour, mixed with oil, as a grain offering for each lamb, as a burnt offering of sweet fragrance, an offering made by fire to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
28.14: ‘And their drink offering is half a hin of wine for a bull, and one-third of a hin for a ram, and one-fourth of a hin for a lamb. This is the burnt offering for each month throughout the months of the year,
28.15: and one male goat as a sin offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is prepared, besides the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
28.16: ‘And in the first month, on the fourteenth day, is the Pesaḥ of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄,
28.17: and on the fifteenth day of this month is a Festival. For seven days unleavened bread is eaten.
28.18: ‘On the first day is a qodesh gathering, you do no servile work.
28.19: ‘And you shall bring near an offering made by fire as a burnt offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄: two young bulls and one ram, and seven lambs a year old, perfect ones they are for you,
28.20: and their grain offering, fine flour mixed with oil. Prepare three-tenth parts for a bull, and two-tenth parts for a ram.
28.21: ‘Prepare one-tenth part for each of the seven lambs,
28.22: and one goat as a sin offering, to make atonement for you.
28.23: ‘Prepare these besides the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.
28.24: ‘According to these you are to prepare the food of the offering made by fire daily for seven days, as a sweet fragrance to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄. It is prepared besides the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
28.25: ‘And on the seventh day you have a qodesh gathering, you do no servile work.
28.26: ‘And on the day of the first-fruits, when you bring a new grain offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 at your Festival of Shaḇuoth, you have a qodesh gathering, you do no servile work.
28.27: ‘And you shall bring near a burnt offering as a sweet fragrance to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄: two young bulls, one ram, and seven lambs a year old,
28.28: with their grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenth parts for each bull, two-tenth parts for the one ram,
28.29: one-tenth part for each of the seven lambs,
28.30: one male goat to make atonement for you,
28.31: perfect ones they are for you. Prepare them with their drink offerings, besides the continual burnt offering with its grain offering.

29.1: ‘And in the seventh month, on the first of the month, you have a qodesh gathering, you do no servile work, it is a Yom Teruah for you.
29.2: ‘And you shall prepare a burnt offering as a sweet fragrance to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄: one young bull, one ram, seven lambs a year old, perfect ones,
29.3: and their grain offering: fine flour mixed with oil, three-tenth parts for the bull, two-tenth parts for the ram,
29.4: and one-tenth part for each of the seven lambs,
29.5: and one male goat as a sin offering, to make atonement for you,
29.6: besides the burnt offering with its grain offering for the New Moon, the continual burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings, according to their Right-Ruling, as a sweet fragrance, an offering made by fire to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
29.7: ‘And on the tenth of this seventh month you have a qodesh gathering, and you shall afflict your beings, you do no work.
29.8: ‘And you shall bring near a burnt offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, a sweet fragrance: one young bull, one ram, seven lambs a year old, perfect ones they are for you,
29.9: and their grain offering: fine flour mixed with oil, three-tenth parts for the bull, two-tenth parts for the one ram,
29.10: one-tenth part for each of the seven lambs,
29.11: one male goat as a sin offering, besides the sin offering for atonement the continual burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings.
29.12: ‘And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month you have a qodesh gathering, you do no servile work. And you shall celebrate a Festival to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 seven days,
29.13: and you shall bring near a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, a sweet fragrance to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄: thirteen young bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs a year old, perfect ones they are,
29.14: and their grain offering: fine flour mixed with oil, three-tenth parts for each of the thirteen bulls, two-tenth parts for each of the two rams,
29.15: and one-tenth part for each of the fourteen lambs,
29.16: and one male goat as a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
29.17: ‘Then on the second day: twelve young bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs a year old, perfect ones,
29.18: and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the Right-Ruling,
29.19: and one male goat as a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings.
29.20: ‘And on the third day eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs a year old perfect ones,
29.21: and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the Right-Ruling,
29.22: and one goat as a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
29.23: ‘Then on the fourth day: ten bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs a year old perfect ones,
29.24: and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the Right-Ruling,
29.25: and one male goat as a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
29.26: ‘Then on the fifth day: nine bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs a year old perfect ones,
29.27: and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the Right-Ruling,
29.28: and one goat as a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
29.29: ‘Then on the sixth day: eight bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs a year old perfect ones,
29.30: and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the Right-Ruling,
29.31: and one goat as a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
29.32: ‘Then on the seventh day: seven bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs a year old, perfect ones,
29.33: and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the Right-Ruling,
29.34: and one goat as a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
29.35: ‘On the eighth day you have an assembly, you do no servile work,
29.36: and you shall bring near a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, a sweet fragrance to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄: one bull, one ram, seven lambs a year old perfect ones,
29.37: their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the Right-Ruling,
29.38: and one goat as a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
29.39: ‘These you prepare to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 at your Appointed Times, besides your vowed offerings and your voluntary offerings, as your burnt offerings and your grain offerings, as your drink offerings and your peace offerings.’ ”
29.40: And Mosheh spoke to the children of Yisra’ĕl according to all 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 had commanded Mosheh.

3.1: And these are the generations of Aharon and Mosheh when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke with Mosheh on Mount Sinai.
3.2: And these are the names of the sons of Aharon: Naḏaḇ, the first-born, and Aḇihu, El’azar, and Ithamar.
3.3: These are the names of the sons of Aharon, the anointed kohenim, whom he ordained to act as kohenim.
3.4: And Naḏaḇ and Aḇihu had died before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 when they brought strange fire before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 in the Wilderness of Sinai. And they had no children. So El’azar and Ithamar acted as kohenim in the presence of Aharon their father.
3.5: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Mosheh, saying,
3.6: “Bring the tribe of Lĕwi near, and put them before Aharon the kohĕn, and they shall serve him,
3.7: and shall guard his duty and the duty of all the congregation before the Tent of Appointment, to do the service of the Mishkan.
3.8: “And they shall guard all the furnishings of the Tent of Appointment, and the duty of the children of Yisra’ĕl, to do the service of the Mishkan.
3.9: “And you shall give the Lĕwites to Aharon and his sons. They are the given ones, given to him from among the children of Yisra’ĕl.
3.10: “And appoint Aharon and his sons, and they shall guard their kehunnah. And the stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”
3.11: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Mosheh, saying,
3.12: “Now look, I Myself have taken the Lĕwites from among the children of Yisra’ĕl instead of every first-born who opens the womb among the children of Yisra’ĕl. And the Lĕwites shall be Mine,
3.13: because all the first-born are Mine. On the day that I struck all the first-born in the land of Mitsrayim, I qadosh to Myself all the first-born in Yisra’ĕl, both man and beast. They are Mine, I am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.”
3.14: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Mosheh in the Wilderness of Sinai, saying,
3.15: “Register the children of Lĕwi by their fathers’ houses, by their clans. Register every male from a month old and above.”
3.16: So Mosheh registered them according to the word of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, as he had been commanded.
3.17: And these were the sons of Lĕwi by their names: Gĕreshon, and Qehath, and Merari.
3.18: And these are the names of the sons of Gĕreshon by their clans: Liḇni and Shim’i.
3.19: And the sons of Qehath by their clans: Amram and Yitshar, Ḥeḇron and Uzzi’ĕl.
3.20: And the sons of Merari by their clans: Maḥli and Mushi. These are the clans of the Lĕwites by their fathers’ houses.
3.21: From Gĕreshon came the clan of the Liḇnites and the clan of the Shim’ites. These were the clans of the Gĕreshonites.
3.22: Their registered ones, according to the number of all the males from a month old and above, their registered ones were seven thousand five hundred.
3.23: The clans of the Gĕreshonites were to camp westward, behind the Mishkan,
3.24: and the leader of the fathers’ house of the Gĕreshonites: Elyasaph, son of La’ĕl.
3.25: And the duty of the children of Gĕreshon in the Tent of Appointment was the Mishkan, and the Tent with its covering, and the covering of the door of the Tent of Appointment,
3.26: and the screens of the courtyard and the covering of the door of the courtyard, which is around the Mishkan and the altar, and their cords, according to all its service.
3.27: And from Qehath came the clan of the Amramites, and the clan of the Yitsharites, and the clan of the Ḥeḇronites, and the clan of the Uzzi’ĕlites. These were the clans of the Qehathites.
3.28: In number, all the males, from a month old and above, were eight thousand six hundred, guarding the duty of the qodesh place.
3.29: The clans of the children of Qehath were to camp on the south side of the Mishkan.
3.30: And the leader of the fathers’ house of the clans of the Qehathites was Elitsaphan, son of Uzzi’ĕl.
3.31: And their duty was the ark, and the table, and the lampstand, and the altars, and the utensils of the qodesh place used in the service, and the covering, and all its service.
3.32: And El’azar, son of Aharon the kohĕn, was to be chief over the leaders of the Lĕwites, with oversight of those who guard the duty of the qodesh place.
3.33: From Merari came the clan of the Maḥlites and the clan of the Mushites. These were the clans of Merari.
3.34: And the number of their registered ones, all the males from a month old and above, were six thousand two hundred.
3.35: And the leader of the fathers’ house of the clans of Merari was Tsuri’ĕl, son of Aḇiḥayil. These were to camp on the north side of the Mishkan.
3.36: And the appointed duty of the children of Merari was the boards of the Mishkan, and its bars, and its columns, and its sockets, and its utensils, and all its service,
3.37: and the columns of the courtyard all around, with their sockets, and their pegs, and their cords.
3.38: And those who were to camp before the Mishkan on the east, before the Tent of Appointment, were Mosheh and Aharon, and his sons, guarding the duty of the Miqdash, and the duty of the children of Yisra’ĕl. But the stranger who came near was to be put to death.
3.39: All the registered ones of the Lĕwites, whom Mosheh and Aharon registered at the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, by their clans, all the males from a month old and above, were twenty-two thousand.
3.40: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 said to Mosheh, “Register all the first-born males of the children of Yisra’ĕl from a month old and above, and take the number of their names.
3.41: “And you shall take the Lĕwites for Me - I am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 - instead of all the first-born among the children of Yisra’ĕl, and the livestock of the Lĕwites instead of all the first-born among the livestock of the children of Yisra’ĕl.”
3.42: And Mosheh registered all the first-born among the children of Yisra’ĕl as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 had commanded him.
3.43: And all the first-born males, by the number of names, from one month old and above of their registered ones, were twenty-two thousand two hundred and seventy-three.
3.44: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Mosheh, saying,
3.45: “Take the Lĕwites instead of all the first-born among the children of Yisra’ĕl, and the livestock of the Lĕwites instead of their livestock. And the Lĕwites shall be Mine, I am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
3.46: “And for the ransom of the two hundred and seventy-three of the first-born of the children of Yisra’ĕl, who are more than the number of the Lĕwites,
3.47: you shall take five sheqels for each one, head by head - take it by the sheqel of the qodesh place, the sheqel of twenty gĕrahs.
3.48: “And you shall give the silver, the ransom of those who are in excess among them, to Aharon and his sons.”
3.49: And Mosheh took the ransom silver from those who were over and above those who were ransomed by the Lĕwites.
3.50: From the first-born of the children of Yisra’ĕl he took the silver, one thousand three hundred and sixty-five pieces, according to the sheqel of the qodesh place.
3.51: And Mosheh gave their ransom silver to Aharon, and to his sons, according to the word of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 had commanded Mosheh.

30.1: And Mosheh spoke to the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Yisra’ĕl, saying, “This is the word which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 has commanded:
30.2: “When a man vows a vow to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, or swears an oath to bind himself by some agreement, he does not break his word, he does according to all that comes out of his mouth.
30.3: “Or if a woman vows a vow to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, and binds herself by some agreement while in her father’s house in her youth,
30.4: and her father hears her vow and the agreement by which she has bound herself, and her father has kept silent towards her, then all her vows shall stand, and every agreement with which she has bound herself stands.
30.5: “But if her father forbids her on the day that he hears, then none of her vows nor her agreements by which she has bound herself stand. And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 pardons her, because her father has forbidden her.
30.6: “But if she at all belongs to a husband, while bound by her vows or by a rash utterance from her lips by which she bound herself,
30.7: and her husband hears it, and he has kept silent towards her on the day that he hears, then her vows shall stand, and her agreements by which she bound herself do stand.
30.8: “But if her husband forbids her on the day that he hears it, then he has nullified her vow which she vowed, and the rash utterance of her lips by which she bound herself, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 pardons her.
30.9: “But any vow of a widow or a divorced woman, by which she has bound herself, stands against her.
30.10: “And if she vowed in her husband’s house, or bound herself by agreement with an oath,
30.11: and her husband heard it, and has kept silent towards her and did not forbid her, then all her vows shall stand, and every agreement by which she bound herself stands.
30.12: “But if her husband clearly nullified them on the day he heard them, then whatever came from her lips concerning her vows or concerning the agreement binding her, it does not stand - her husband has nullified them, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 pardons her.
30.13: “Every vow and every binding oath to afflict her being, let her husband confirm it, or let her husband nullify it.
30.14: “But if her husband is altogether silent at her from day to day, then he confirms all her vows or all the agreements that bind her - he confirms them, because he kept silent towards her on the day that he heard.
30.15: “But if he nullifies them after he has heard, then he shall bear her wickedness.”
30.16: These are the Laws which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 commanded Mosheh, between a man and his wife, and between a father and his daughter in her youth in her father’s house.

31.1: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Mosheh, saying,
31.2: “Take vengeance for the children of Yisra’ĕl on the Miḏyanites. After that you are to be gathered to your people.”
31.3: And Mosheh spoke to the people, saying, “Arm some of yourselves for the campaign, and let them go against the Miḏyanites to take vengeance for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 on Miḏyan.
31.4: “Send a thousand from each tribe of all the tribes of Yisra’ĕl for the campaign.”
31.5: So there were supplied from the tribes of Yisra’ĕl one thousand from each tribe, twelve thousand armed ones for the campaign.
31.6: And Mosheh sent them on the campaign, one thousand from each tribe, them and Pineḥas son of El’azar the kohĕn on the campaign, with the qodesh utensils and the trumpets for sounding in his hand.
31.7: And they fought against the Miḏyanites, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 commanded Mosheh, and slew all the males.
31.8: And they slew the melaḵim of Miḏyan with the rest of those who were pierced: Ewi, and Reqem, and Tsur, and Ḥur, and Reḇa, the five melaḵim of Miḏyan. And they slew Bil’am son of Be’or with the sword.
31.9: And the sons of Yisra’ĕl took all the women of Miḏyan captive, with their little ones, and took as spoil all their livestock, and all their possessions.
31.10: And they burned with fire all the cities where they dwelt, and all their settlements.
31.11: And they took all the spoil and all the booty, both of man and beast.
31.12: And they brought the captives, and the booty, and the spoil to Mosheh, and to El’azar the kohĕn, and to the congregation of the children of Yisra’ĕl, to the camp in the desert plains of Mo’aḇ by the Yardĕn of Yeriḥo.
31.13: And Mosheh, and El’azar the kohĕn, and all the leaders of the congregation, went to meet them outside the camp.
31.14: But Mosheh was wroth with the officers of the army, with the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, who had come from the campaign.
31.15: And Mosheh said to them, “Have you kept all the women alive?
31.16: “Look, they are the ones who caused the children of Yisra’ĕl, through the word of Bil’am, to trespass against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 in the matter of Pe’or, and there was a plague among the congregation of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
31.17: “And now, slay every male among the little ones. And every woman who has known a man by lying with a man you shall slay.
31.18: “But keep alive for yourselves all the female children who have not known a man by lying with a man.
31.19: “And you, camp outside the camp seven days. Whoever has slain any being, and whoever has touched any slain, cleanse yourselves and your captives on the third day and on the seventh day.
31.20: “And cleanse every garment, and every object of leather and whatever is made of goats’ hair, and every object of wood.”
31.21: And El’azar the kohĕn said to the men of the campaign who went to the battle, “This is the Law of the Torah which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 commanded Mosheh:
31.22: “Only the gold, and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
31.23: every object that passes through fire, you put through the fire, and it shall be clean; only, let it be cleansed with the water for uncleanness. And whatever does not pass through fire you pass through water.
31.24: “And you shall wash your garments on the seventh day and be clean, and afterwards come into the camp.”
31.25: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Mosheh, saying,
31.26: “Count up the plunder that was taken, of man and of beast, you and El’azar the kohĕn and the heads of the fathers of the congregation.
31.27: “And you shall divide the plunder into two parts, between those who took part in the battle, who went out on the campaign, and all the congregation.
31.28: “And put aside a levy for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 on the men of battle who went out on the campaign: one out of every five hundred, of man, and of the cattle, and of the donkeys, and of the sheep.
31.29: “Take it from their half, and give it to El’azar the kohĕn as a contribution to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
31.30: “And from the children of Yisra’ĕl’s half you shall take one of every fifty, of man, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the sheep, of all the livestock, and give them to the Lĕwites guarding the duty of the Mishkan of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.”
31.31: And Mosheh and El’azar the kohĕn did as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 commanded Mosheh.
31.32: And the booty remaining from the plunder, which the people of the campaign had taken, was six hundred and seventy-five thousand sheep,
31.35: and thirty-two thousand human beings in all, of women who had not known a man by lying with a man.
31.36: And the half, the portion for those who went out on the campaign, was in number three hundred and thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,
31.37: and the levy unto 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 of the sheep was six hundred and seventy-five.
31.38: And the cattle were thirty-six thousand, of which the levy unto 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 was seventy-two.
31.39: And the donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred, of which the levy unto 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 was sixty-one.
31.40: And the human beings were sixteen thousand, of which the levy unto 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 was thirty-two beings.
31.41: So Mosheh gave the levy which was the contribution unto 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 to El’azar the kohĕn, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 commanded Mosheh.
31.42: And from the children of Yisra’ĕl’s half, which Mosheh divided from the men who campaigned:
31.43: now the half belonging to the congregation was three hundred and thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,
31.45: and thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,
31.47: Then Mosheh took from the children of Yisra’ĕl’s half: one out of every fifty, drawn from man and beast, and gave them to the Lĕwites, who guarded the duty of the Mishkan of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 commanded Mosheh.
31.48: And the officers who were over thousands of the campaign, the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, came near to Mosheh,
31.49: and they said to Mosheh, “Your servants have taken a count of the fighting men under our command, and not a man of us is missing.
31.50: “So we have brought an offering for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, what every man found of ornaments of gold: armlets and bracelets and signet rings and earrings and necklaces, to make atonement for ourselves before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.”
31.51: And Mosheh and El’azar the kohĕn received the gold from them, all the fashioned ornaments.
31.52: And all the gold of the offering that they presented to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, from the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty sheqels.
31.53: The men of the campaign had taken spoil, every man for himself.
31.54: And Mosheh and El’azar the kohĕn received the gold from the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the Tent of Appointment as a remembrance for the children of Yisra’ĕl before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.

32.1: And the children of Re’uḇĕn and the children of Gaḏ had much livestock, a large number. And they saw the land of Ya’zĕr and the land of Gil’aḏ and saw that the place was a place for livestock.
32.2: So the children of Gaḏ and the children of Re’uḇĕn came and spoke to Mosheh, and to El’azar the kohĕn, and to the leaders of the congregation, saying,
32.3: “Ataroth, and Diḇon, and Ya’zĕr, and Nimrah, and Ḥeshbon, and El’alĕh, and Seḇam, and Neḇo, and Be’on,
32.4: the land which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 had smitten before the congregation of Yisra’ĕl, is a land for livestock, and your servants have livestock.”
32.5: And they said, “If we have found favor in your eyes, let this land be given to your servants as a possession, and do not let us pass over the Yardĕn.”
32.6: And Mosheh said to the children of Gaḏ and to the children of Re’uḇĕn, “Are your brothers to go into the battle while you yourselves sit here?
32.7: “Now why do you discourage the heart of the children of Yisra’ĕl from passing over into the land which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 has given them?
32.8: “Thus your fathers did when I sent them away from Qaḏĕsh Barnĕa to see the land.
32.9: “For when they went up to the wadi Eshkol and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Yisra’ĕl, so that they did not go into the land which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 had given them.
32.10: Then the displeasure of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 burned on that day, and He swore an oath, saying,
32.11: ‘Not one of the men who came up from Mitsrayim, from twenty years old and above, is to see the land of which I swore to Aḇraham, Yitsḥaq, and Ya’aqoḇ, because they did not follow Me completely,
32.12: except Kalĕḇ son of Yephunneh, the Qenizzite, and Yahoshua son of Nun, for they have followed 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 completely.’
32.13: “So the displeasure of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 burned against Yisra’ĕl, and He made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation that had done evil in the eyes of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 was destroyed.
32.14: “And see, you have risen in your father’s place, an increase of men, sinners, to add still more the burning displeasure of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 against Yisra’ĕl.
32.15: “For if you turn away from following Him, He shall once again leave them in the wilderness, and you shall destroy all these people.”
32.16: Then they came near to him and said, “Let us build sheep-enclosures here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones,
32.17: but let us ourselves be armed, hastening before the children of Yisra’ĕl until we have brought them to their place. And our little ones shall dwell in the walled cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
32.18: “We shall not return to our homes until every one of the children of Yisra’ĕl has received his inheritance.
32.19: “For we shall not inherit with them on the other side of the Yardĕn and beyond, because our inheritance has fallen to us on this eastern side of the Yardĕn.”
32.20: And Mosheh said to them, “If you make this promise: if you arm yourselves before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 for battle,
32.21: and all your armed ones pass over the Yardĕn before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 until He has driven out His enemies from before Him,
32.22: and the land has been subdued before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, then afterward you shall return, and be guiltless before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 and before Yisra’ĕl. And this land shall be your possession before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
32.23: “But if you do not do so, then see, you shall sin against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, and know: your sin is going to find you out.
32.24: “Build cities for your little ones and enclosures for your sheep, and do what you have promised.”
32.25: And the children of Gaḏ and the children of Re’uḇĕn spoke to Mosheh, saying, “Your servants are going to do as my master commands.
32.26: “Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock are going to be there in the cities of Gil’aḏ,
32.27: but your servants are passing over, every armed one of the army, before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, to battle, as my master says.”
32.28: And Mosheh gave command concerning them to El’azar the kohĕn, to Yahoshua son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Yisra’ĕl.
32.29: And Mosheh said to them, “If the children of Gaḏ and the children of Re’uḇĕn pass over the Yardĕn with you, every man armed for battle before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, and the land has been subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gil’aḏ as a possession.
32.30: “But if they do not pass over armed with you, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Kena’an.”
32.31: Then the children of Gaḏ and the children of Re’uḇĕn answered, saying, “As 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 has said to your servants, so we do.
32.32: “We ourselves are passing over armed before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 into the land of Kena’an, but the possession of our inheritance remains with us beyond the Yardĕn.”
32.33: So Mosheh gave to the children of Gaḏ, to the children of Re’uḇĕn, and to half the tribe of Menashsheh, son of Yosĕph, the reign of Siḥon meleḵ of the Amorites and the reign of Oḡ meleḵ of Bashan, the land with its cities within the borders, the cities of the land round about.
32.34: And the children of Gaḏ built Diḇon and Ataroth and Aro’ĕr,
32.35: and Atroth, Shophan and Ya’zĕr and Yoḡbehah,
32.36: and Bĕyth Nimrah and Bĕyth Haran, walled cities, and enclosures for sheep.
32.37: And the children of Re’uḇĕn built Ḥeshbon and El’alĕh and Qiryathayim,
32.38: Neḇo and Ba’al Me’on - the names being changed - and Siḇmah. And they gave other names to the cities which they built.
32.39: And the sons of Maḵir son of Menashsheh went to Gil’aḏ and took it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were in it.
32.40: So Mosheh gave Gil’aḏ to Maḵir, son of Menashsheh, and he dwelt in it.
32.41: And Ya’ir son of Menashsheh went and took its small towns, and called them Ḥawoth Ya’ir.
32.42: And Noḇaḥ went and took Qenath and its villages, and he called it Noḇaḥ, after his own name.

33.1: These are the departures of the children of Yisra’ĕl, who went out of the land of Mitsrayim by their divisions under the hand of Mosheh and Aharon.
33.2: And Mosheh wrote down the starting points of their departures at the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, and these are their departures according to their starting points:
33.3: So they departed from Ra’meses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month, on the morrow of the Pesaḥ the children of Yisra’ĕl went out with a high hand before the eyes of all the Mitsrites,
33.4: and the Mitsrites were burying all their first-born, whom 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 had smitten among them. Also on their mighty ones 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 had executed judgments.
33.5: Then the children of Yisra’ĕl departed from Ra’meses and camped at Sukkoth.
33.6: And they departed from Sukkoth and camped at Ĕtham, which is on the edge of the wilderness.
33.7: And they departed from Ĕtham and turned back to Pi ha’Ḥiroth, which is before Ba’al Tsephon. And they camped near Miḡdol.
33.8: And they departed from before ha’Ḥiroth and passed over through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, went three days’ journey in the Wilderness of Ĕtham, and camped at Marah.
33.9: And they departed from Marah and came to Ĕlim. And at Ĕlim were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, so they camped there.
33.10: And they departed from Ĕlim and camped by the Sea of Reeds.
33.11: And they departed from the Sea of Reeds and camped in the Wilderness of Sin.
33.12: And they departed from the Wilderness of Sin and camped at Dophqah.
33.13: And they departed from Dophqah and camped at Alush.
33.14: And they departed from Alush and camped at Rephiḏim, and there was no water for the people to drink.
33.15: And they departed from Rephiḏim and camped in the Wilderness of Sinai.
33.16: And they departed from the Wilderness of Sinai and camped at Qiḇroth ha’Tta’awah.
33.17: And they departed from Qiḇroth ha’Tta’awah and camped at Ḥatsĕroth.
33.18: And they departed from Ḥatsĕroth and camped at Rithmah.
33.19: And they departed from Rithmah and camped at Rimmon Perets.
33.20: And they departed from Rimmon Perets and camped at Liḇnah.
33.21: And they departed from Liḇnah and camped at Rissah.
33.22: And they departed from Rissah and camped at Qehĕlathah.
33.23: And they departed from Qehĕlathah and camped at Mount Shapher.
33.24: And they departed from Mount Shapher and camped at Ḥaraḏah.
33.25: And they departed from Ḥaraḏah and camped at Maqhĕloth.
33.26: And they departed from Maqhĕloth and camped at Taḥath.
33.27: And they departed from Taḥath and camped at Teraḥ.
33.28: And they departed from Teraḥ and camped at Mithqah.
33.29: And they departed from Mithqah and camped at Ḥashmonah.
33.30: And they departed from Ḥashmonah and camped at Mosĕroth.
33.31: And they departed from Mosĕroth and camped at Benĕy Ya’aqan.
33.32: And they departed from Benĕy Ya’aqan and camped at Ḥor ha’Giḏgaḏ.
33.33: And they departed from Ḥor ha’Giḏgaḏ and camped at Yotḇathah.
33.34: And they departed from Yotḇathah and camped at Aḇronah.
33.35: And they departed from Aḇronah and camped at Etsyon Geḇer.
33.36: And they departed from Etsyon Geḇer and camped in the Wilderness of Tsin, which is Qaḏĕsh.
33.37: And they departed from Qaḏĕsh and camped at Mount Hor, on the boundary of the land of Eḏom.
33.38: Then Aharon the kohĕn went up to Mount Hor at the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 and died there in the fortieth year after the children of Yisra’ĕl had come out of the land of Mitsrayim, on the first day of the fifth month.
33.39: Now Aharon was one hundred and twenty-three years old when he died on Mount Hor.
33.40: And the meleḵ of Araḏ, the Kena’anite, who dwelt in the Negeḇ in the land of Kena’an, heard of the coming of the children of Yisra’ĕl.
33.41: So they departed from Mount Hor and camped at Tsalmonah.
33.42: And they departed from Tsalmonah and camped at Punon.
33.43: And they departed from Punon and camped at Oḇoth.
33.44: And they departed from Oḇoth and camped at Iyĕ ha’Aḇiram, at the border of Mo’aḇ.
33.45: And they departed from Iyim and camped at Diḇon Gaḏ.
33.46: And they departed from Diḇon Gaḏ and camped at Almon Diḇlathayemah.
33.47: And they departed from Almon Diḇlathayemah and camped in the mountains of Aḇarim, before Neḇo.
33.48: And they departed from the mountains of Aḇarim and camped in the desert plains of Mo’aḇ by the Yardĕn of Yeriḥo.
33.49: And they camped by the Yardĕn, from Bĕyth Yeshimoth as far as Aḇĕl ha’Shittim in the desert plains of Mo’aḇ.
33.50: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Mosheh in the desert plains of Mo’aḇ by the Yardĕn of Yeriḥo, saying,
33.51: “Speak to the children of Yisra’ĕl, and say to them, ‘When you have passed over the Yardĕn into the land of Kena’an,
33.52: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and shall destroy all their engraved stones, and shall destroy all their molded images, and lay waste all their high places,
33.53: and you shall possess the land and dwell in it, for I have given you the land to possess.
33.54: ‘And you shall divide the land by lot as an inheritance among your clans. To the larger you give a larger inheritance, and to the smaller you give a smaller inheritance. Wherever the lot falls to anyone, that is his. You inherit according to the tribes of your fathers.
33.55: ‘And if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then it shall be that those whom you let remain shall be pricks in your eyes and thorns in your sides, and they shall trouble you in the land where you dwell.
33.56: ‘And it shall be that I do to you as I thought to do to them.’ ”

34.1: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Mosheh, saying,
34.2: “Command the children of Yisra’ĕl, and say to them, ‘When you come into the land of Kena’an, this is the land which falls to you as an inheritance, the land of Kena’an to its boundaries:
34.3: ‘Then your southern border shall be from the Wilderness of Tsin along the border of Eḏom, and your southern border shall be eastward from the end of the Salt Sea.
34.4: ‘Then your border shall turn from the southern side of the Ascent of Aqrabbim, continue to Tsin, and be on the south of Qaḏĕsh Barnĕa, and it shall go on to Ḥatsar Addar, and continue to Atsmon.
34.5: ‘And the border shall turn from Atsmon to the wadi of Mitsrayim, and it shall end at the Sea.
34.6: ‘As for the western border, you shall have the Great Sea for a border, this is your western border.
34.7: ‘And this is your northern border: From the Great Sea you mark out your borderline to Mount Hor,
34.8: from Mount Hor you mark out your border to the entrance of Ḥamath, and the edge of the border shall be toward Tseḏaḏ,
34.9: and the border shall proceed to Ziphron, and it shall end at Ḥatsar Ĕynan. This is your northern border.
34.10: ‘And you shall mark out your eastern border from Ḥatsar Ĕynan to Shepham,
34.11: and the border shall go down from Shepham to Riḇlah on the east side of Ayin, and the border shall go down and reach to the eastern side of the Sea of Kinnereth.
34.12: ‘And the border shall go down along the Yardĕn, and it shall end at the Salt Sea. This is your land with its surrounding boundaries.’ ”
34.13: And Mosheh commanded the children of Yisra’ĕl, saying, “This is the land which you inherit by lot, which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 has commanded to give to the nine tribes and to the half-tribe.
34.14: “For the tribe of the children of Re’uḇĕn according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gaḏ according to the house of their fathers, have received their inheritance. And the half-tribe of Menashsheh has received its inheritance.
34.15: “The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Yardĕn of Yeriḥo eastward, toward the sunrise.”
34.16: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Mosheh, saying,
34.17: “These are the names of the men who divide the land among you as an inheritance: El’azar the kohĕn, and Yahoshua son of Nun.
34.18: “And take one leader of every tribe to divide the land for the inheritance.
34.19: “And these are the names of the men. From the tribe of Yahuḏah: Kalĕḇ son of Yephunneh.
34.20: “And from the tribe of the children of Shim’on: Shemu’ĕl son of Ammihuḏ.
34.21: “From the tribe of Binyamin: Eliḏaḏ son of Kislon.
34.22: “And a leader from the tribe of the children of Dan: Buqqi son of Yoḡli.
34.23: “From the sons of Yosĕph: a leader from the tribe of the children of Menashsheh, Ḥanni’ĕl son of Ĕphoḏ.
34.24: “And a leader from the tribe of the children of Ephrayim: Qemu’ĕl son of Shiphtan.
34.25: “And a leader from the tribe of the children of Zeḇulun: Elitsaphan son of Parnaḵ.
34.26: “And a leader from the tribe of the children of Yissasḵar: Palti’ĕl son of Azzan.
34.27: “And a leader from the tribe of the children of Ashĕr: Aḥihuḏ son of Shelomi.
34.28: “And a leader from the tribe of the children of Naphtali: Peḏah’ĕl son of Ammihuḏ.”
34.29: These are the ones 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 commanded to divide the inheritance among the children of Yisra’ĕl in the land of Kena’an.

35.1: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Mosheh in the desert plains of Mo’aḇ by the Yardĕn of Yeriḥo, saying,
35.2: “Command the children of Yisra’ĕl that they shall give the Lĕwites cities to dwell in from the inheritance of their possession. Also give the Lĕwites open land around the cities.
35.3: “And they shall have the cities to dwell in, and their open land for their cattle, and for their herds, and for all their livestock.
35.4: “And the open land of the cities which you give the Lĕwites are from the wall of the city outward a thousand ammah all around.
35.5: “And you shall measure outside the city on the east side two thousand ammah, and on the south side two thousand ammah, and on the west side two thousand ammah, and on the north side two thousand ammah. And the city is in the middle. This is to them the open land for the cities.
35.6: “And the cities which you give to the Lĕwites are the six cities of refuge, which you give to him who killed someone to flee to, and to these you add forty-two cities.
35.7: “All the cities which you give to the Lĕwites are forty-eight, these with their open land.
35.8: “And the cities which you give are from the possession of the children of Yisra’ĕl. From the larger you give many, from the smaller you give few, each one gives some of its cities to the Lĕwites, in proportion to the inheritance that each inherits.”
35.9: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Mosheh, saying,
35.10: “Speak to the children of Yisra’ĕl, and say to them, ‘When you pass over the Yardĕn into the land of Kena’an,
35.11: then you shall choose cities to be cities of refuge for you, that the one who accidentally killed someone shall flee there.
35.12: ‘And they shall be cities of refuge for you from the revenger, and the one who killed someone is not to die until he stands before the congregation in right-ruling.
35.13: ‘And of the cities which you give, six are to be cities of refuge.
35.14: ‘Give three cities beyond the Yardĕn, and give three cities in the land of Kena’an, as cities of refuge.
35.15: ‘These six cities are for refuge for the children of Yisra’ĕl, and for the sojourner, and for the settler in their midst, for anyone who accidentally kills someone to flee there.
35.16: ‘But if he has smitten him with an instrument of iron, so that he dies, he is a murderer. The murderer shall certainly be put to death.
35.17: ‘And if he has smitten him with a stone in the hand, by which one could die, and he dies, he is a murderer. The murderer shall certainly be put to death.
35.18: ‘Or if he has smitten him with a wooden instrument that could kill, and he dies, he is a murderer. The murderer shall certainly be put to death.
35.19: ‘The revenger of blood himself puts the murderer to death. When he meets him, he puts him to death.
35.20: ‘And if he thrusts him through in hatred, or throws at him while lying in wait, so that he dies,
35.21: or in enmity he smites him with his hand so that he dies, the one who smote him shall certainly be put to death, for he is a murderer. The revenger of blood puts the murderer to death when he meets him.
35.22: ‘But if he pushes him suddenly without enmity, or throws at him without lying in wait,
35.23: or uses a stone, by which a man could die, throwing it at him without seeing him, so that he dies, while he was not his enemy or seeking his harm,
35.24: then the congregation shall judge between him who killed someone and the revenger of blood, according to these Right-Rulings.
35.25: ‘And the congregation shall rescue the one who killed someone from the hand of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall return him to the city of refuge where he had fled, and he shall remain there until the death of the kohĕn ha’gadol who was anointed with the qodesh oil.
35.26: ‘But if the one who killed someone at any time goes outside the limits of the city of refuge where he fled,
35.27: and the revenger of blood finds him outside the limits of his city of refuge, and the revenger of blood kills him who killed someone, he is not guilty of blood,
35.28: because he should have remained in his city of refuge until the death of the kohĕn ha’gadol. But after the death of the kohĕn ha’gadol he who killed someone is to return to the land of his possession.
35.29: ‘And these shall be for a Law of Right-Ruling to you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
35.30: ‘Whoever kills someone has to be put to death as a murderer by the mouth of witnesses, but one witness does not bear witness against someone to die.
35.31: ‘And take no ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death, but he shall certainly be put to death.
35.32: ‘And take no ransom for him who has fled to his city of refuge to return to dwell in the land before the death of the kohĕn.
35.33: ‘And do not profane the land where you are, for blood profanes the land, and the land is not pardoned for the blood that is shed on it, except by the blood of him who shed it.
35.34: ‘And do not defile the land which you inhabit, in the midst of which I dwell, for I, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, am dwelling in the midst of the children of Yisra’ĕl.’ ”

36.1: And the heads of the fathers of the clans of the children of Gil’aḏ, son of Maḵir, son of Menashsheh, of the clans of the sons of Yosĕph, came near and spoke before Mosheh and before the leaders, the heads of the fathers of the children of Yisra’ĕl,
36.2: and said, “𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 commanded my master to give the land as an inheritance by lot to the children of Yisra’ĕl, and my master was commanded by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 to give the inheritance of our brother Tselapheḥaḏ to his daughters.
36.3: “Now if they are married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Yisra’ĕl, then their inheritance shall be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be added to the inheritance of the tribe into which they marry, and taken from the lot of our inheritance.
36.4: “And if the Yoḇĕl of the children of Yisra’ĕl takes place, then their inheritance shall be added to the inheritance of the tribe into which they marry, and their inheritance taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.”
36.5: And Mosheh commanded the children of Yisra’ĕl according to the word of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, saying, “What the tribe of the sons of Yosĕph speaks is right.
36.6: “This is the word which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 has commanded, for the daughters of Tselapheḥaḏ, saying, ‘Let them marry who is good in their eyes, but let them marry only within the clan of their father’s tribe.’
36.7: “And the inheritance of the children of Yisra’ĕl is not to change hands from tribe to tribe, for every one of the children of Yisra’ĕl is to cling to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
36.8: “And every daughter possessing an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Yisra’ĕl is to be the wife of one of the clan of her father’s tribe, so that the children of Yisra’ĕl possess each the inheritance of his fathers.
36.9: “Thus the inheritance is not to change hands from one tribe to another, but every tribe of the children of Yisra’ĕl is to cling to its own inheritance.”
36.10: As 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 commanded Mosheh, so did the daughters of Tselapheḥaḏ.
36.11: For Maḥlah, Tirtsah, and Ḥoḡlah, and Milkah, and No’ah, the daughters of Tselapheḥaḏ, were married to the sons of their father’s brothers.
36.12: And they were married into the clans of the children of Menashsheh, the son of Yosĕph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of their father’s clan.
36.13: These are the Commands and the Right-Rulings which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 commanded the children of Yisra’ĕl by the hand of Mosheh in the desert plains of Mo’aḇ by the Yardĕn of Yeriḥo.

4.1: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Mosheh, and to Aharon, saying,
4.2: “Take a census of the sons of Qehath from among the children of Lĕwi, by their clans, by their fathers’ house,
4.3: from thirty years old and above, even to fifty years old, all who enter the service to do the work in the Tent of Appointment.
4.4: “This is the service of the sons of Qehath in the Tent of Appointment, the most qodesh matters:
4.5: “At the breaking of camp, Aharon and his sons shall come, and they shall take down the covering veil and cover the ark of the Witness with it,
4.6: and shall put on it a covering of fine leather, and spread over that an all-blue wrapper, and shall insert its poles.
4.7: “And on the table of showbread they shall spread a blue wrapper, and shall put on it the dishes, and the ladles, and the bowls, and the jars for pouring, and the showbread on it.
4.8: “And they shall spread over them a scarlet wrapper, and cover the same with a covering of fine leather, and shall insert its poles,
4.9: and shall take a blue wrapper and cover the lampstand of the light, with its lamps, and its snuffers, and its trays, and all its oil vessels, by which they serve it.
4.10: “And they shall put it with all its utensils in a covering of fine leather, and put it on a bar.
4.11: “And over the golden altar they shall spread a blue wrapper, and cover it with a covering of fine leather, and shall insert its poles,
4.12: and shall take all the utensils of service with which they serve in the qodesh place, and shall put them in a blue wrapper, cover them with a covering of fine leather, and put them on a bar,
4.13: and shall remove the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple wrapper over it,
4.14: and shall put on it all its utensils by which they serve there: the fire holders, the forks, and the shovels, and the basins, and all the utensils of the altar, and shall spread on it a covering of fine leather, and insert its poles.
4.15: “And when Aharon and his sons have finished covering the qodesh objects and all the furnishings of the qodesh place at the breaking of camp, then the sons of Qehath shall come to lift them, but let them not touch that which is qodesh, lest they die. These are the burden of the sons of Qehath in the Tent of Appointment.
4.16: “And the oversight of El’azar, son of Aharon the kohĕn, is the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily grain offering, and the anointing oil, and the oversight of all the Mishkan and all that is in it, with the qodesh place and its furnishings.”
4.17: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Mosheh, and to Aharon, saying,
4.18: “Do not cut off the tribe of the clans of the Qehathites from among the Lĕwites,
4.19: but do this to them, and they shall live and not die when they approach the most qodesh objects: Aharon and his sons shall go in and appoint each of them to his service and his burden.
4.20: “They are not, however, to go in to watch while the qodesh objects are being covered, lest they die.”
4.21: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Mosheh, saying,
4.22: “Take a census also of the sons of Gĕreshon, by their fathers’ house, by their clans.
4.23: “Register them, from thirty years old and above, even to fifty years old, all who enter to perform the service, to do the service in the Tent of Appointment.
4.24: “This is the service of the clans of the Gĕreshonites, in serving and in bearing burdens:
4.25: “And they shall bear the curtains of the Mishkan and the Tent of Appointment with its covering, the covering of fine leather that is on it, the covering for the door of the Tent of Appointment,
4.26: and the screens of the courtyard and the covering for the door of the gate of the courtyard, which is around the Mishkan and altar, and their cords, all the equipment for their service and all that is made for them - so shall they serve.
4.27: “Aharon and his sons are to command all the service of the sons of the Gĕreshonites, all their burden and all their service. And you shall appoint to them all the duty of all their burden.
4.28: “This is the service of the clans of the sons of Gĕreshon in the Tent of Appointment. And let their duties be under the hand of Ithamar, son of Aharon the kohĕn.
4.29: “As for the sons of Merari, register them by their clans and by their fathers’ house.
4.30: “Register them, from thirty years old and above, even to fifty years old, all who enter the service to do the work of the Tent of Appointment.
4.31: “And this is the duty of their burden, according to all their service for the Tent of Appointment: the boards of the Mishkan, and its bars, and its columns, and its sockets,
4.32: and the columns around the courtyard with their sockets, and their pegs, and their cords, with all their equipment and all their service. And assign by name the equipment of the duty of their burden.
4.33: “This is the service of the clans of the sons of Merari, as all their service for the Tent of Appointment, under the hand of Ithamar, son of Aharon the kohĕn.”
4.34: So Mosheh and Aharon and the leaders of the congregation registered the sons of the Qehathites by their clans and by their fathers’ house,
4.35: from thirty years old and above, even to fifty years old, all who entered the service for work in the Tent of Appointment.
4.36: And their registered ones, by their clans, were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.
4.37: These were the registered ones of the clans of the Qehathites, all those serving in the Tent of Appointment, whom Mosheh and Aharon registered according to the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 by the hand of Mosheh.
4.38: And those registered ones of the sons of Gĕreshon, by their clans and by their fathers’ house,
4.39: from thirty years old and above, even to fifty years old, all who entered the service for work in the Tent of Appointment,
4.40: the registered ones, by their clans, by their fathers’ house, were two thousand six hundred and thirty.
4.41: These were the registered ones of the clans of the sons of Gĕreshon, of all who serve in the Tent of Appointment, whom Mosheh and Aharon registered according to the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
4.42: And those of the clans of the sons of Merari who were registered, by their clans, by their fathers’ house,
4.43: from thirty years old and above, even to fifty years old, all who entered the service for work in the Tent of Appointment,
4.44: the registered ones, by their clans were three thousand two hundred.
4.45: These were the registered ones of the clans of the sons of Merari, whom Mosheh and Aharon registered according to the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 by the hand of Mosheh.
4.46: All the registered ones of the Lĕwites, whom Mosheh and Aharon and the leaders of Yisra’ĕl registered, by their clans and by their fathers’ houses,
4.47: from thirty years old and above, even to fifty years old, all who came to do the work of service and the work of bearing burdens in the Tent of Appointment,
4.48: their registered ones were eight thousand five hundred and eighty.
4.49: According to the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 they were registered by the hand of Mosheh, each according to his service and according to his burden, thus were they registered by him, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 commanded Mosheh.

5.1: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Mosheh, saying,
5.2: “Command the children of Yisra’ĕl to send out of the camp every leper, and everyone who has a discharge, and whoever becomes defiled for a being.
5.3: “Send out both male and female, send them outside the camp, so that they do not defile their camps in the midst of which I dwell.”
5.4: And the children of Yisra’ĕl did so, to send them outside the camp. As 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 had spoken to Mosheh, so the children of Yisra’ĕl did.
5.5: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Mosheh, saying,
5.6: “Speak to the children of Yisra’ĕl, ‘When a man or woman commits any sin that men commit in trespass against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, and that being is guilty,
5.7: then they shall confess their sin which they have done. And he shall restore his guilt in its principal, plus one-fifth of it, and give it to whom he has been guilty.
5.8: ‘But if the man has no relative to restore the guilt to, the guilt which is restored goes to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, for the kohĕn, in addition to the ram of the atonement with which atonement is made for him.
5.9: ‘And every contribution of all the qodesh gifts of the children of Yisra’ĕl, which they bring to the kohĕn, becomes his.
5.10: ‘And every man’s qodesh gifts becomes his, whatever any man gives the kohĕn becomes his.’ ”
5.11: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Mosheh, saying,
5.12: “Speak to the children of Yisra’ĕl, and say to them, ‘When any man’s wife turns aside and has committed a trespass against him,
5.13: and a man has intercourse with her, and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband, and it is concealed that she has defiled herself, and there was no witness against her, nor was she caught,
5.14: and a spirit of jealousy comes upon him and he becomes jealous of his wife who has defiled herself, or a spirit of jealousy comes upon him and he becomes jealous of his wife although she has not defiled herself,
5.15: then the man shall bring his wife to the kohĕn. And he shall bring the offering for her, one-tenth of an ĕphah of barley flour. He is not to pour oil on it or put frankincense on it, because it is a grain offering of jealousy, an offering for remembering, for bringing wickedness to remembrance.
5.16: ‘And the kohĕn shall bring her near, and shall make her stand before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
5.17: ‘And the kohĕn shall take qodesh water in an earthen vessel, and take some of the dust that is on the floor of the Mishkan and put it into the water.
5.18: ‘And the kohĕn shall make the woman stand before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, and shall uncover the woman’s head, and put the offering for remembering in her hands, which is the grain offering of jealousy, while the kohĕn holds in his hand the bitter water that brings a curse.
5.19: ‘And the kohĕn shall make her swear, and say to the woman, “If no man has lain with you, and if you have not turned aside to uncleanness under your husband, be free from this bitter water that brings a curse.
5.20: “But if you have turned aside under your husband, and if you have defiled yourself and some man other than your husband has lain with you”-
5.21: then the kohĕn shall make the woman swear with the oath of the curse, and he shall say to the woman - “𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 make you a curse and an oath among your people, when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 makes your thigh waste away and your abdomen swell,
5.22: and this water that causes the curse shall go into your inward parts, and make your abdomen swell and your thigh waste away.” And the woman shall say, “Amĕn, amĕn.”
5.23: ‘And the kohĕn shall write these curses in a book, and shall wipe them off into the bitter water,
5.24: and shall make the woman drink the bitter water that brings the curse, and the water that brings the curse shall enter her to become bitter.
5.25: ‘And the kohĕn shall take the grain offering of jealousy from the woman’s hand, and shall wave the offering before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, and bring it to the altar.
5.26: ‘And the kohĕn shall take a hand filled with the offering, as its remembrance offering, and burn it on the altar, and afterward make the woman drink the water.
5.27: ‘And when he has made her drink the water, then it shall be, if she has defiled herself and has committed a trespass against her husband, that the water that brings the curse shall enter her and become bitter, and her abdomen shall swell, and her thigh shall waste away, and the woman shall become a curse among her people.
5.28: ‘But if the woman has not defiled herself, and is clean, then she shall be clear and shall conceive children.
5.29: ‘This is the Torah of jealousy, when a wife turns aside under her husband and defiles herself,
5.30: or when a spirit of jealousy comes upon a man, and he becomes jealous of his wife. Then he shall make the woman stand before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, and the kohĕn shall do to her all this Torah.
5.31: ‘And the man shall be clear from wickedness, but the woman bear her wickedness.’ ”

6.1: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Mosheh, saying,
6.2: “Speak to the children of Yisra’ĕl, and say to them, ‘When a man or woman separates, by making a vow of a Nazirite, to be separate to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄,
6.3: he separates from wine and strong drink - he drinks neither vinegar of wine nor vinegar of strong drink, neither does he drink any grape juice, nor eat grapes or raisins.
6.4: ‘All the days of his separation he does not eat whatever is made of the grapevine, from seed to skin.
6.5: ‘All the days of the vow of his separation a razor does not come upon his head. Until the days are completed for which he separates himself to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, he is qodesh. He shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow long.
6.6: ‘All the days of his separation to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 he does not go near a dead body.
6.7: ‘He does not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother or his sister, when they die, because his separation to Elohim is on his head.
6.8: ‘All the days of his separation he is qodesh to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
6.9: ‘And when anyone dies beside him in an instant, suddenly, and he has defiled the head of his separation, then he shall shave his head on the day of his cleansing - on the seventh day he shaves it.
6.10: ‘And on the eighth day he brings two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the kohĕn, to the door of the Tent of Appointment,
6.11: and the kohĕn shall prepare one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, and shall make atonement for him, because he sinned by reason of the dead body. And he shall qadosh his head on that day,
6.12: and shall separate to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 the days of his separation, and shall bring a male lamb a year old, as a guilt offering. But the former days are not counted, because his separation was defiled.
6.13: ‘And this is the Torah of the Nazirite: When the days of his separation are completed, he is brought to the door of the Tent of Appointment,
6.14: and he shall bring his offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄: one male lamb a year old, a perfect one, as a burnt offering, and one ewe lamb a year old, a perfect one, as a sin offering, and one ram, a perfect one, as a peace offering,
6.15: and a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, and unleavened thin cakes anointed with oil, and their grain offering with their drink offerings.
6.16: ‘And the kohĕn shall bring them before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 and prepare his sin offering and his burnt offering.
6.17: ‘And he shall prepare the ram as a peace offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, together with the basket of unleavened bread. And the kohĕn shall prepare its grain offering and its drink offering.
6.18: ‘And the Nazirite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the Tent of Appointment, and shall take the hair from the head of his separation and shall put it on the fire which is under the slaughtering of the peace offering.
6.19: ‘And the kohĕn shall take the boiled shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake from the basket, and one unleavened thin cake, and put them upon the hands of the Nazirite after he has shaved his dedicated hair.
6.20: ‘Then the kohĕn shall wave them, a wave offering before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄. It is qodesh for the kohĕn, besides the breast of the wave offering and besides the thigh of the contribution. And afterwards the Nazirite shall drink wine.’
6.21: “This is the Torah of the Nazirite who vows to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 the offering for his separation, and besides that, whatever else his hand is able to provide. According to the vow which he takes, so he shall do according to the Torah of his separation.”
6.22: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Mosheh, saying,
6.23: “Speak to Aharon and his sons, saying, ‘This is how you baraḵ the children of Yisra’ĕl. Say to them:
6.25: 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 make His face shine upon you, and show favor to you;
6.26: 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 lift up His face upon you, and give you peace.’ ”
6.27: “Thus they shall put My Name on the children of Yisra’ĕl, and I Myself shall baraḵ them.”

7.1: And it came to be, when Mosheh finished putting up the Mishkan, that he anointed it and qadosh it and all its furnishings, as well as the altar and all its utensils. Thus he anointed them and qadosh them.
7.2: And the leaders of Yisra’ĕl, heads of their fathers’ houses who were the leaders of the tribes and over the ones registered, drew near,
7.3: and they brought their offering before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄: six covered wagons and twelve cattle, a wagon for every two of the leaders, and for each one a bull. And they brought them near before the Mishkan.
7.4: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Mosheh, saying,
7.5: “Accept from them, and they shall be used in doing the service of the Tent of Appointment. And you shall give them to the Lĕwites, each one according to his service.”
7.6: And Mosheh took the wagons and the cattle, and gave them to the Lĕwites.
7.7: He gave two wagons and four cattle to the sons of Gĕreshon, according to their service.
7.8: And he gave four wagons and eight cattle to the sons of Merari, according to their service, under the hand of Ithamar, son of Aharon the kohĕn.
7.9: But to the sons of Qehath he gave none, because theirs was the service of the qodesh objects, which they bore on their shoulders.
7.10: And the leaders brought the dedication of the altar in the day it was anointed. So the leaders brought their offering before the altar.

7.84: This was the dedication of the altar from the leaders of Yisra’ĕl, when it was anointed: twelve silver dishes, twelve silver bowls, twelve gold ladles.
