7.89: And when Mosheh went into the tent of Appointment to speak with Him, he heard the voice of One speaking to him from above the lid of atonement that was on the ark of the Witness, from between the two keruḇim. Thus He spoke to him.

8.1: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Mosheh, saying,
8.2: “Speak to Aharon, and say to him, ‘When you put up the lamps, let the seven lamps give light in front of the lampstand.’ ”
8.3: And Aharon did so. He put up the lamps to face toward the front of the lampstand, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 commanded Mosheh.
8.4: And this is the work of the lampstand: beaten work of gold, from its base to its blossoms it is beaten work. According to the pattern which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 had shown Mosheh, so he made the lampstand.
8.5: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Mosheh, saying,
8.6: “Take the Lĕwites from among the children of Yisra’ĕl, and you shall cleanse them,
8.7: and do this to them to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of sin offering on them, and they shall shave all their body, and shall wash their garments, and cleanse themselves,
8.8: and shall take a young bull with its grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, while you take another young bull as a sin offering.
8.9: “And you shall bring the Lĕwites before the Tent of Appointment, and you shall assemble all the congregation of the children of Yisra’ĕl.
8.10: “And you shall bring the Lĕwites before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, and the children of Yisra’ĕl shall lay their hands on the Lĕwites,
8.11: and Aharon shall wave the Lĕwites before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, a wave offering from the children of Yisra’ĕl - so shall they be for doing the service of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
8.12: “And the Lĕwites shall lay their hands on the heads of the young bulls. And one shall be prepared as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, to make atonement for the Lĕwites.
8.13: “And you shall have the Lĕwites stand before Aharon and his sons, and then wave them, a wave offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
8.14: “Thus you shall separate the Lĕwites from among the children of Yisra’ĕl, and the Lĕwites shall be Mine.
8.15: “Then after that the Lĕwites shall go in to do service in the Tent of Appointment, when you have cleansed them and waved them as a wave offering.
8.16: “For they are given ones, given to Me from among the children of Yisra’ĕl. I have taken them for Myself instead of all who open the womb, the first-born of all the children of Yisra’ĕl.
8.17: “For all the first-born among the children of Yisra’ĕl are Mine, both man and beast. On the day that I smote all the first-born in the land of Mitsrayim I qadosh them unto Myself.
8.18: “And I have taken the Lĕwites instead of all the first-born of the children of Yisra’ĕl.
8.19: “And I have given the Lĕwites as a gift to Aharon and his sons from among the children of Yisra’ĕl, to do the service of the children of Yisra’ĕl in the Tent of Appointment, and to make atonement for the children of Yisra’ĕl, that there be no plague among the children of Yisra’ĕl when the children of Yisra’ĕl come near the qodesh place.”
8.20: Thus Mosheh and Aharon and all the congregation of the children of Yisra’ĕl did to the Lĕwites according to all that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 commanded Mosheh concerning the Lĕwites, so the children of Yisra’ĕl did to them.
8.21: And the Lĕwites cleansed themselves and washed their garments, and Aharon waved them, a wave offering before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, and Aharon made atonement for them to cleanse them.
8.22: Then after that the Lĕwites went in to do their service in the Tent of Appointment before Aharon and his sons as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 commanded Mosheh concerning the Lĕwites, so they did to them.
8.23: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Mosheh, saying,
8.24: “This applies to the Lĕwites: From twenty-five years old and above let him come into active service in the service of the Tent of Appointment,
8.25: and at the age of fifty years they retire from active service of the service, and serve no more,
8.26: but they shall attend with their brothers in the Tent of Appointment, to guard the duty, but shall do no service. Thus you shall do to the Lĕwites regarding their duties.”

9.1: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Mosheh in the Wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they had come out of the land of Mitsrayim, saying,
9.2: “Now, let the children of Yisra’ĕl perform the Pesaḥ at its Appointed Time.
9.3: “On the fourteenth day of this month, between the evenings, perform it at its Appointed Time. According to all its Laws and Right-Rulings you perform it.”
9.4: And Mosheh spoke to the children of Yisra’ĕl to perform the Pesaḥ.
9.5: So they performed the Pesaḥ on the fourteenth day of the first month, between the evenings, in the Wilderness of Sinai. According to all that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 commanded Mosheh, so the children of Yisra’ĕl did.
9.6: But there were men who were defiled for a being of a man, so that they were not able to perform the Pesaḥ on that day. So they came before Mosheh and Aharon that day,
9.7: and those men said to him, “We are defiled for the being of a man. Why are we withheld from bringing near the offering of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 at its Appointed Time among the children of Yisra’ĕl?”
9.8: And Mosheh said to them, “Wait, let me hear what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 commands concerning you.”
9.9: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Mosheh, saying,
9.10: “Speak to the children of Yisra’ĕl, saying, ‘When any male of you or your generations is unclean for a being, or is far away on a journey, he shall still perform the Pesaḥ of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
9.11: ‘On the fourteenth day of the second month, between the evenings, they perform it - with unleavened bread and bitter herbs they eat it.
9.12: ‘They do not leave of it until morning, and they do not break a bone of it. According to all the Laws of the Pesaḥ they perform it.
9.13: ‘But the man who is clean and is not on a journey, and has failed to perform the Pesaḥ, that same being shall be cut off from among his people, because he did not bring the offering of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 at its Appointed Time - that man bears his sin.
9.14: ‘And when a stranger sojourns among you, then he shall perform the Pesaḥ of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄. He shall do so according to the Law of the Pesaḥ and according to its Right-Ruling. You have one Law, both for the stranger and the native of the land.’ ”
9.15: And on the day that the Mishkan was raised up, the cloud covered the Mishkan, the Tent of the Witness. From evening until morning it was above the Mishkan like the appearance of fire.
9.16: Thus it was continually: the cloud covered it by day, and the appearance of fire by night.
9.17: And whenever the cloud was taken up from above the Tent, after that the children of Yisra’ĕl would depart. And in the place where the cloud dwelt, there the children of Yisra’ĕl would camp.
9.18: At the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 the children of Yisra’ĕl departed, and at the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 they camped. They remained camped as long as the cloud dwelt above the Mishkan.
9.19: Even when the cloud lingered many days above the Mishkan, the children of Yisra’ĕl guarded the Charge of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, and did not depart.
9.20: And so it was, when the cloud was above the Mishkan a few days: according to the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 they camped, and according to the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 they would depart.
9.21: And so it was, when the cloud dwelt only from evening until morning: when the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they departed. Whether by day or by night, whenever the cloud was taken up, they departed.
9.22: Whether two days, or a month, or a year that the cloud lingered above the Mishkan to dwell upon it, the children of Yisra’ĕl camped, and did not depart. But when it was taken up, they departed.
9.23: At the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 they camped, and at the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 they departed. They guarded the Charge of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, at the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 by the hand of Mosheh.
